home.heroTitle: Protect your home in Spain — no monthly fees
home.heroLead: Ajax alarms, cameras and sensors: instant alerts on your phone, video that counts as evidence, and your water under control. Installation and support on WhatsApp, in your language.
scenario.second: I have a holiday home on the coast
scenario.empty: My home sits empty much of the year
scenario.main: I live here and want peace of mind
how.step1Body: Motion, a door or window opening, smoke or a water leak — the system picks it up the moment it happens.
how.step2Body: Within seconds, wherever you are. The app works in English, Spanish and Russian. Hubs with a 4G SIM and battery keep alerting even if the power or Wi-Fi is cut (model-dependent).
how.step3Body: Cameras record the incident: evidence for the police and your insurer, and the basis for acting fast.
how.selfNote: No monthly fees means self-monitoring: the alert goes to you, not to a security company. You see what is happening and call the police with evidence in hand. If you would rather connect to a certified monitoring centre, we will give you honest advice.
home.packsLead: Every home is different: we fine-tune the pack with you on WhatsApp and give you a fixed quote, no strings attached.
pack.priceNote: The price depends on the equipment you choose — ask for a WhatsApp quote, no strings attached.
pack1.name: Eyes at home
pack1.items: 2 Wi-Fi cameras|Entry sensors on the doors|Instant phone alerts
pack2.name: Anti-okupa
pack2.items: Ajax hub with a 4G SIM|Motion and entry sensors|Indoor siren|Camera to verify what's happening
pack3.name: Empty home premium
pack3.for: Months away without nasty surprises: intrusion and water
pack3.items: Everything in Anti-okupa|Water-leak sensors|Automatic water shut-off (WaterStop)|Visible outdoor siren
home.serviceTitle: Service on WhatsApp, in your language
home.serviceLead: Send us photos or a floor plan of your home and we'll propose a system with a fixed quote. Installation in the Benidorm–Alicante area, or delivery with guided setup on WhatsApp.
home.whyTitle: No fees: the equipment is yours
home.whyBody: You buy the system once and it's yours: no lock-in contract, no obligatory monthly fee, no price hike next year. And we extend it whenever you like, sensor by sensor.
home.gdprNote: We install in line with the GDPR: cameras point only at your property, and the approved video-surveillance sign is included.
